scoring_justification: The headline quantities (band gap, birefringence, SHG coefficients, dipole moments) are scalar DFT results; the agent reports them directly in JSON files. A full recompute from raw DFT outputs is not feasible in the lightweight verifier sandbox. Comparison against paper-reported reference values with tolerances appropriate for method variations is the strongest feasible tier.

outputs.description: Direct band gap of the crystal computed with GGA-PBE, compared to a hidden reference value.
Birefringence at 546.1 nm and 1064 nm, compared to hidden reference values.
Independent NLO tensor components d31 and d33 at 1064 nm, compared to hidden reference values.
Total unit-cell dipole moments (z-component) of the [PO4]3- groups and [ScO4F2] polyhedra, compared to hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: All scored quantities are derived from first-principles DFT using the same functional (PBE) and pseudopotential type as described. The hidden reference values are the corresponding DFT results reported in the original study; the checker compares within predefined tolerances appropriate for DFT method variations.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for band gap, birefringence, SHG coefficients, and dipole moments.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: 'The band structures ... exhibited direct band gaps of 4.492 eV.'; 'The birefringence ... was also calculated to be 0.0750 at 546.1 nm and 0.0630 at 1064 nm based on DFT calculation.'; 'The calculated NLO coefficients ... d31 and d33, were 0.18 and 0.24 pm V^{-1} at a wavelength of 1064 nm.'; Table 4 lists total PO4 dipole 6.044 D and total ScO4F2 dipole 3.632 D.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported DFT results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual DFT-derived values the paper claims; embedded inline for self-contained checking without network fetch.
